overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures Brahmi Leaf Powder for B2B buyers who need a fine, consistent ingredient for bulk supply. The product is dehydrated and processed in a controlled workflow that includes sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. We support OEM and private label requirements, with custom mesh and packaging available on request.

As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we supply Brahmi Leaf Powder in bulk with an MOQ of 5 Kg. The powder is offered in 80-100 mesh, with moisture at ≤ 7.0% and a shelf life of 24 months. We also provide samples on request, export documentation support, and packing options suited to commercial buyers, including 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.
